body.statement: For every \(m\in\mathcal M_n(B)\), the vectors \((A_l,C_l,H_l)\) are independent across \(l\), each has categorical probabilities \((q_l,q_l,1-2q_l)\), and \(A_lC_l=0\). The observed-data construction in \(\mathrm{def{:}block\text{-}ht}\) satisfies \(\mathbb E_Z[X_l(D)]=w_l\{\mu_l(a)-\mu_l(b)\}\), \(\sum_l\operatorname{Var}_Z\{X_l(D)\}\le S/2\), and \(|X_l(D)-\mathbb E_ZX_l(D)|\le w_l/q_l\le M\).
body.justification: The exact categorical reduction preserves mutual exclusion and supplies the heterogeneous variance and increment scales for an implementable statistic.
body.gap: AronowSamii2017 gives general exposure-probability Horvitz--Thompson algebra, while UganderKarrerBackstromKleinberg2013 studies full-neighborhood exposure; neither isolates this independent nonidentical weighted-erasure experiment.
body.consumer: The upper interval, lower prior, and package diagnostic use the same exact block law and do not approximate dependence within blocks.
